essence: Therefore, the point at issue has been conclusively established beforehand.
Therefore, one must come to rest immediately after uttering the praṇava.
Therefore, establishing an abode is included as a preparatory step.
Therefore, augmentation by that power makes them both empowered and fully identified with it.
Therefore, the knowable object in question belongs to the mantric sphere.
